supersedes.reason: Independent review reproduced five classes of audit-invariant bypass: forgeable and TOCTOU-prone evidence, invalid Git execution identity, illegal campaign and cancellation transitions, non-durable approved release gates, and self-review. This manifest records the corrections and preserves the original submission and changes-requested review record.

checks.result: The exact review-fix commit passed repository, runtime, architecture, agent-protocol, ADR, CI, formatting, linting, typing, packaging, 67 foundation tests, and canonical backlog validation.
The exact review-fix commit passed the foundation checks again, all 19 security tests, and a live scan of 31 packages with 30 reported license findings and zero blocking findings.

Complete stored evidence, semantic state, hierarchy, lease, dependency, review-independence, release-gate, and schema validation passed for 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.

evidence: Evidence is parsed from one immutable byte snapshot, hashed from that same snapshot, and revalidated completely whenever a stored reference is checked; logical duplicate submissions and undeclared follow-up evidence are rejected.

Exact evidence now binds the current full commit, actual branch and canonical worktree, claimed base ancestry, truthful changed files, named passing commands, exact criterion mappings, explicit empty unverified items, and a clean tracked tree without unrelated untracked files.

Claim, start, and resume require normalized identities plus a real current Git branch, full current HEAD, and matching canonical worktree; illegal PAUSED starts, incompatible resumes, unauthorized or repeated cancellation, and active-campaign lease bypasses are rejected.

Approved release gates are enforced as durable semantic invariants, reopening a task behind an approved gate is denied, and task, slice, and capability self-review by the owning implementer is rejected.
Every mutation retains schema and semantic revalidation, stable hierarchy enforcement, and exclusive-lock compare-and-swap replacement with recovery tests.

Reviewer-derived mutation tests cover evidence swapping, forged stored manifests, duplicate aliases, stale commits, false or empty changed-file claims, missing commands, forged branches, dirty and unrelated files, invalid Git execution metadata, campaign transition bypasses, cancellation, gate durability, and self-review.
The full foundation suite passes 67 tests at the exact review-fix commit; the security-local suite independently passes 19 security tests and the live supply-chain scan with zero blocking findings.

AGENTS.md, planning/README.md, and the Codex tracking guide document normalized Git execution identity, mandatory worktree metadata, immutable evidence snapshots, superseding evidence, independent reviews, durable release gates, and legal campaign recovery transitions.

The correction is confined to workflow contracts, documentation, backlog audit state, focused tests, taskctl, and the preserved first-pass evidence; it does not expand application, UI, architecture, dependency, or later-wave implementation scope.
